desc: A tree stump, coral or fungus - irregular organic volume. Where dense triangles finally earn their cost.
source_prompt: a single tree stump with thick exposed roots, splintered broken top, deep bark ridges, the whole stump inside the frame with margin on all sides, three-quarter view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no soil, no leaves, no undergrowth, no other plants
output: untextured GLB mesh, POSITION attribute only, ~525k tris, ~8.5 MB, 19.5 s
usable_for: sculpt base, set dressing blockout, terrain feature, 3D-print base
not_usable_for: direct game import - needs retopology, UV unwrap and texture bake
note: The one preset where the 525k triangle count is a feature rather than a burden: bark ridges and root knuckles are real displacement in the surface, so they survive as geometry instead of needing a normal map. Decimate gently here - below about 20 percent the ridges flatten and the stump becomes a smooth lump. threshold 0.55 leans slightly open to keep the splintered top from filling in; not rendered per-preset on this box.
